highlights: £35 tickets include a welcome drink and all materials
Nights listed for 13 Nov, 4 Dec and 12 Dec 2026
The venue becomes a mini gallery for end-of-night photos
Followers hear first about new dates and special prices

howItWorks.title: Book a seat
howItWorks.text: Tickets for each public night are sold through the organiser's Eventbrite page. Seats are limited, and nights often sell out.

howItWorks.title: Arrive and settle in
howItWorks.text: Doors open at 6:40pm and check-in runs from 7pm. It is a chance to grab your drink, find your spot and mingle before the painting starts.

howItWorks.title: Paint step by step
howItWorks.text: From 7:30pm the artist guides everyone through each stage of the painting and is on hand to help throughout.

howItWorks.title: Gallery and photos
howItWorks.text: At the end of the night the venue is turned into a mini gallery and photos are taken to celebrate everyone's work, before guests head home with their paintings.

goodToKnow.text: Guests are asked to arrive 15–20 minutes early to check in and get settled.
Aprons are provided, but it is best to wear something you do not mind getting paint on.

faqs.q: Do I need any painting experience?
faqs.a: No. The nights are designed for beginners, and the artist guides everyone from start to finish.

faqs.q: What if I can no longer make it?
faqs.a: Tickets are not refundable, but the organiser offers a transfer to an event on a different date.
Yes, as long as they attend with a parent or legal guardian.

faqs.q: How do I hear about new dates?
faqs.a: Follow the organiser's Eventbrite page, which announces new dates and special prices first.

serviceDetails.name: Paint & Pour Night, Epping
serviceDetails.more: Listed dates are Friday 13 November and Friday 4 December 2026, each running from 7pm to 10pm, with tickets at £35. The event page describes Carpino Lounge as cosy and stylish.

serviceDetails.name: Paint & Pour Night, Chingford
serviceDetails.more: The listed date is Saturday 12 December 2026, from 7pm to 10pm, with tickets at £35. The format matches the Epping nights.

serviceDetails.name: Beginner-friendly tuition
serviceDetails.more: The sessions are pitched at total beginners and seasoned painters alike, as a relaxed, no-pressure way to let creativity flow.

serviceDetails.name: Materials and a take-home canvas
serviceDetails.more: Bryony says guests leave with a painting they are proud of, or at least one that makes a great story, plus a few new friends.

notes: All four Eventbrite pages were fetched on 27 October 2026. The listed dates and £35 ticket price are for public nights and will go out of date; check Eventbrite for current listings. The business has no website, and none of its fetched pages describe private, exclusive or mobile bookings, group sizes, private-event pricing, deposits or the event types it caters for, so none are included. The event agenda gives 'Mini Gallery & Photo Time' as 10pm but shows the slot as 9:30pm–10:30pm, while the events are listed as ending at 10pm, so no end time for the gallery was stated. Instagram could not be viewed without logging in. No reviews or ratings were used.
